name: Christian Leroy Duncan
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: An awkward, long, switch-stance British striker (the former Cage Warriors champion) on a five-fight streak, latest a clear win over Jared Cannonier. Dangerous with knees, kicks and spinning strikes; his grappling defense is the question.

how_they_fight.Striking: About 4.2 significant strikes a minute while absorbing only 1.5. Kicks early, glides at angles, uses front kicks, jumping and standing knees and spinning attacks; staggered Cannonier with a spinning elbow and dropped him with a kick.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Little offensive grappling. Cannonier took him down and controlled him for about six minutes, and walked him to the fence in round three.
how_they_fight.Defense: Very hard to hit cleanly at range; the fence and clinch are where he's vulnerable.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has never fought five rounds in the UFC.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Creative, but can over-commit when he smells a finish (Cannonier landed back when he got too aggressive).

concerns: Takedown defense against an elite grappler
keys_to_beat: Take him down and hold him there
Pressure him to the fence and clinch

news.text: Beat Jared Cannonier by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) for his fifth straight win.
